Chalo, main batati hoon. Kitchen mein Maa ne garam roti banayi, aur tum do bhai-behen ho: dono ke tukde barabar hone chahiye. Yeh roti 2 barabar tukdon mein kati hai, aur ek tukde mein rang hai. Fraction mein neeche wala number roti ke kul barabar tukde ginta hai, upar wala number, jitne tukde humne liye. Ek tukda rangin hai, ek bina rang ka. Toh rangin tukde ke liye kaunsa fraction likhoge?

Pizza mein ek tukda bada hai aur do chhote. Pizza ka ek chhota tukda lo. Kya woh pizza ka ek-tihaai hai, haan ya nahi?

Neeche wala number 3 isliye hai, kyunki poore circle ke 3 barabar tukde hain. Ek aur tukde mein rang bharo. Ab rangin tukdon ka fraction kya hoga?
